exposure: Uterine artery ligation before placental delivery (UALBPD)
uterine artery ligation before placental delivery (UALBPD)
outcome: Number of packed red blood cell (RBC) units transfused
finding: Bilateral uterine artery ligation before placental delivery in women with placenta accreta can effectively reduce the amount of intraoperative blood loss, the incidence of postpartum hemorrhage (PPH), and the risk of complications such as hysterectomy.
